selection_formula: 0.65 normalized mean gray change + 0.35 normalized HSV hue Bhattacharyya distance
endpoint_guard: first and last at 5% and 95% of actual decode count
candidate_rounding: interpolate between exact integer 5%/95% endpoints; no answer-label changes
scientific_scope: No model training/test-score tuning; label-blind fixed algorithm, grouped-heldout videos
